name: Conditional SMB, network-flow and MCP services
trigger: Documented capability gap or retained-service need

steps.action: Evaluate baseline API, object and monitoring alternatives
Approve only required SMB, flow or MCP function
Restore scoped state and least-privilege identities
Test client paths, firewall and data access
Add backup, alert and retirement owner

acceptance_tests: Unhealthy historical MCP not treated as healthy
No new permanent service without owner/cost
failure: Preserve the current held/stopped/retired intent. Do not start, delete, prune, extend an old run window, or reactivate a public route without a separate owner decision.

run_contract.owner: Assigned accountable role in OpenProject before activation
run_contract.retry: Bounded retry only after retryability classification; unknown remote effects HOLD
run_contract.observability: workflow_id, run_id, correlation_id, state and redacted error; no raw PII labels
run_contract.recovery: Restore HOLD; reapply suppression/deletion and reconcile external receipts before replay
run_contract.completion: Named output plus acceptance evidence, not merely a running service
